compositeMethod.why: the frozen runtime (155995dd) has no Stokes term; the design allows a runtime-external composite forcing
compositeMethod.control: GLORYS12V1 15.810070 m (STEP 25C Condition C normalized dataset) sampled at 3-hourly instants t0 + 3h*k, k = 0..24, by linear interpolation between its daily frames (identical to the runtime's own linear interpolation at those instants)
compositeMethod.treatment: control values + WW3 surface Stokes drift (uuss, vuss) at the same instants, bilinearly sampled from the 0.5 degree WW3 nodes (exact multiples of 0.5 = 6/12, so every GLORYS cell lies inside one WW3 cell and the runtime reproduces the WW3 bilinear interpolant exactly)
compositeMethod.equationRealization: U_ocean(runtime) := U_GLORYS + U_Stokes; windage alpha * U_wind applied by the runtime separately, so dX/dt = U_GLORYS + U_Stokes + alpha * U_wind
compositeMethod.grid: GLORYS 1/12 degree nodes cropped to the computation area + one node (runtime value limit)
compositeMethod.timeAxis: 25 frames t0 .. t0+72 h at 10800 s
compositeMethod.mask: GLORYS wet-validity mask OR invalid 4-node WW3 stencil (any frame); identical for control and treatment
compositeMethod.controlNotBitwiseStep25C: the composite time axis (3 h) and mask differ from the STEP 25C Condition C dataset by construction; therefore 6 control runs are executed (design allowance) and their relation to STEP 25C is recorded descriptively, not gated

ww3Gate: identity (source GLOBMULTI, product_version 1.0, grid glob_30m, distribution_statement No restrictions)
3 h axis: all 25 instants present incl. the KE-2 June/July file boundary
release stencil at t0 on WW3 nodes (fresh; KE-2 required)
order: per window KE-1, KE-2, AG-1, AG-2, KE-H1, KE-H3: control 0.002, treatment 0.002, control 0, treatment 0

labelRules.scope: overall stratum, primary alpha 0.002, 72 h; also reported per stratum and for the structural alpha 0 pair
labelRules.rule: STOKES_DESCRIPTIVELY_FAVORED if median delta < -tie AND wins/(wins+losses) >= 2/3; STOKES_DESCRIPTIVELY_DISFAVORED if median delta > +tie AND losses/(wins+losses) >= 2/3; otherwise NO_CLEAR_STOKES_DIFFERENCE; TEST_BLOCKED if any mandatory gate fails

requiredStatements: TEST-06 is a descriptive paired experiment; no statistical significance, causal, universal or operational claim is made.

The only intentional difference between treatment and control is the added WW3 surface Stokes drift (coefficient 1.0, never multiplied by alpha); grid, time axis, mask, wind, alpha, releases and mechanics are identical.
alpha = 0.002 (structural pair alpha = 0), the Stokes coefficient, GLORYS depth and forcing identities are unchanged; no coefficient, alpha, depth or forcing selection was made.
Holdout results are descriptive only; no re-ranking, no selective rerun, no outlier handling.
Any observed Stokes effect is reported as an observed effect under the preregistered metric, not as a physical explanation; STEP 20-29 Phase A results are unchanged.
